intent: Increased body width and wheel track to improve stability and reduce line loss events.
rationale: The telemetry from the last race indicated that the robot struggled with stability, as evidenced by a high number of line loss events (5 out of 8). To improve stability and reduce line loss, I will increase the body width to 0.15m (from 0.1m) and adjust the wheel track to 0.15m (from 0.1m). This should provide a wider base, enhancing balance and reducing the likelihood of tipping over. I expect this change to lead to fewer line loss events in the next race.
